import L4Factoidal.Syntax.Turtle
import L4Factoidal.OWL.RLClosureIndexed
import L4Factoidal.OWL.Refute

open L4Factoidal.RDF L4Factoidal.Syntax L4Factoidal.OWL.Refute

def timed {α : Type} (name : String) (run : Unit → α) : IO α := do
  let start ← IO.monoMsNow
  let ref ← IO.mkRef (run ())
  let stop ← IO.monoMsNow
  let value ← ref.get
  IO.println s!"phase={name} ms={stop - start}"
  (← IO.getStdout).flush
  return value

def main (args : List String) : IO UInt32 := do
  let some path := args.head? | return 2
  let start ← IO.monoMsNow
  let text ← IO.FS.readFile path
  let parsed ← timed "parse-turtle" (fun _ => parseTurtle text)
  let .ok input := parsed | IO.println "parse failed"; return 2
  IO.println s!"inputTriples={input.length}"
  let graph ← timed "indexed-closure" (fun _ => L4Factoidal.OWL.RL.indexedClosureFix input)
  IO.println s!"closureTriples={graph.length}"
  let immediate ← timed "immediate-inconsistency" (fun _ => immediateInconsistency graph)
  IO.println s!"immediate={immediate}"
  let tb ← timed "collect-axioms" (fun _ => collectAxioms graph)
  IO.println s!"axioms={tb.length}"
  let st ← timed "init-state" (fun _ => initState graph)
  IO.println s!"nodes={st.nodes.length}"
  let st := { st with tbox := tb }
  let clash ← timed "first-clash-check" (fun _ => clashNodes graph st)
  IO.println s!"firstClash={clash}"
  let pass ← timed "first-pass" (fun _ => onePass tb graph st)
  IO.println s!"firstPassChanged={pass.2} nodes={pass.1.nodes.length}"
  let result ← timed "search-from-initial" (fun _ => search tb graph st 64)
  IO.println s!"verdict={repr result.1} remaining={result.2} totalMs={(← IO.monoMsNow) - start}"
  return 0

import L4Factoidal.Syntax.Turtle
import L4Factoidal.OWL.RLClosureIndexed
import L4Factoidal.OWL.Refute

open L4Factoidal.RDF L4Factoidal.Syntax L4Factoidal.OWL L4Factoidal.OWL.RL L4Factoidal.OWL.Refute

def timed {α : Type} (name : String) (run : Unit → α) : IO α := do
  IO.println s!"starting={name}"
  (← IO.getStdout).flush
  let start ← IO.monoMsNow
  let ref ← IO.mkRef (run ())
  let stop ← IO.monoMsNow
  let value ← ref.get
  IO.println s!"phase={name} ms={stop - start}"
  (← IO.getStdout).flush
  return value

def main (args : List String) : IO UInt32 := do
  let some path := args.head? | return 2
  let start ← IO.monoMsNow
  let text ← IO.FS.readFile path
  let parsed ← timed "parse-turtle" (fun _ => parseTurtle text)
  let .ok input := parsed | IO.println "parse failed"; return 2
  IO.println s!"inputTriples={input.length}"
  let graph ← timed "indexed-closure" (fun _ => L4Factoidal.OWL.RL.indexedClosureFix input)
  IO.println s!"closureTriples={graph.length}"
  let immediate ← timed "immediate-inconsistency" (fun _ => immediateInconsistency graph)
  IO.println s!"immediate={immediate}"
  let tb ← timed "collect-axioms" (fun _ => collectAxioms graph)
  IO.println s!"axioms={tb.length}"
  let sp ← timed "init-subproperty-pairs" (fun _ => collectPairs graph L4Factoidal.RDFS.rdfsSubPropertyOf)
  let props ← timed "init-property-dedup" (fun _ => ((sp.map (·.1)) ++ (sp.map (·.2))).eraseDups)
  let idx ← timed "init-index" (fun _ => Store.ofIndex (Index.ofGraph graph))
  let us ← timed "init-unsat-named" (fun _ => unsatNamedClasses graph)
  let parseStore := Store.ofGraph graph
  let anonymousRanges ← timed "init-anonymous-ranges" (fun _ => (idx.withPred L4Factoidal.RDFS.rdfsRange).filterMap (fun t =>
    match t.s, t.o with
    | .iri p, .bnode _ => some (p, parseNnfWith us parseStore t.o)
    | _, _ => none))
  let st0 ← timed "init-role-tables" (fun _ => ({
    inv := collectPairs graph L4Factoidal.OWL.RL.owlInverseOf,
    subprop := sp,
    ranges := collectPairs graph L4Factoidal.RDFS.rdfsRange,
    transProps := collectTypedIris graph L4Factoidal.OWL.RL.owlTransitiveProperty,
    funcProps := collectTypedIris graph L4Factoidal.OWL.RL.owlFunctionalProperty,
    subClosure := props.map (fun p => (p, subpropertiesOfRaw sp p)),
    supClosure := props.map (fun p => (p, superpropertiesOfRaw sp p)),
    anonymousRanges := anonymousRanges,
    store := idx } : RState))
  let store := Store.ofGraph graph
  let types ← timed "init-type-inputs" (fun _ => graph.filter (fun t => t.p == L4Factoidal.OWL.RL.rdfType))
  IO.println s!"types={types.length}"
  let parsed ← timed "init-type-expressions" (fun _ => types.map (fun t => (t.s, parseNnfWith us store t.o)))
  let st ← timed "init-insert-labels" (fun _ => parsed.foldl (fun st (i,c) => (addLabel st i c).1) st0)
  IO.println s!"nodes={st.nodes.length} totalMs={(← IO.monoMsNow) - start}"
  return 0

import L4Factoidal.Syntax.Turtle
import L4Factoidal.OWL.RLClosureIndexed
import L4Factoidal.OWL.Refute

open L4Factoidal.RDF L4Factoidal.Syntax L4Factoidal.OWL.Refute

def timed {α : Type} (name : String) (run : Unit → α) : IO α := do
  let start ← IO.monoMsNow
  let ref ← IO.mkRef (run ())
  let stop ← IO.monoMsNow
  let value ← ref.get
  IO.println s!"phase={name} ms={stop - start}"
  (← IO.getStdout).flush
  return value

def quietTimed {α : Type} (run : Unit → α) : IO (α × Nat) := do
  let start ← IO.monoNanosNow
  let ref ← IO.mkRef (run ())
  let stop ← IO.monoNanosNow
  return ((← ref.get), stop - start)

def profilePass (tb : List (L4Factoidal.OWL.ClassExpr × L4Factoidal.OWL.ClassExpr))
    (g : Graph) (st : RState) : IO (RState × Bool) := do
  let start ← IO.monoNanosNow
  let (functional, tFunctional) ← quietTimed (fun _ => injectFunctional st)
  let (globals, tGlobals) ← quietTimed (fun _ => injectGlobalAxioms tb functional.1)
  let mut current := globals.1
  let mut changed := functional.2 || globals.2
  let mut lookupNs := 0
  let mut labelNs := 0
  let mut axiomNs := 0
  let mut edgeNs := 0
  let mut conjNs := 0
  let mut labels := 0
  for node in globals.1.nodes do
    let (ls, tLookup) ← quietTimed (fun _ => labelsOf current node.id)
    lookupNs := lookupNs + tLookup
    for label in ls do
      labels := labels + 1
      let (applied, tLabel) ← quietTimed (fun _ => applyLabelRules g current node.id label)
      current := applied.1
      changed := changed || applied.2
      labelNs := labelNs + tLabel
      let (axioms, tAxiom) ← quietTimed (fun _ => applyAxioms tb current node.id label)
      current := axioms.1
      changed := changed || axioms.2
      axiomNs := axiomNs + tAxiom
    let (edges, tEdge) ← quietTimed (fun _ => applyAxiomsEdges tb g current node.id)
    current := edges.1
    changed := changed || edges.2
    edgeNs := edgeNs + tEdge
    let (conjs, tConj) ← quietTimed (fun _ => applyAxiomsConj tb current node.id)
    current := conjs.1
    changed := changed || conjs.2
    conjNs := conjNs + tConj
  let total := (← IO.monoNanosNow) - start
  IO.println s!"pass functionalMs={tFunctional/1000000} globalMs={tGlobals/1000000} lookupMs={lookupNs/1000000} labelMs={labelNs/1000000} axiomMs={axiomNs/1000000} edgeMs={edgeNs/1000000} conjMs={conjNs/1000000} sumMs={(tFunctional+tGlobals+lookupNs+labelNs+axiomNs+edgeNs+conjNs)/1000000} totalMs={total/1000000} labelVisits={labels}"
  return (current, changed)

def main (args : List String) : IO UInt32 := do
  let some path := args.head? | return 2
  let start ← IO.monoMsNow
  let text ← IO.FS.readFile path
  let parsed ← timed "parse-turtle" (fun _ => parseTurtle text)
  let .ok input := parsed | IO.println "parse failed"; return 2
  IO.println s!"inputTriples={input.length}"
  let graph ← timed "indexed-closure" (fun _ => L4Factoidal.OWL.RL.indexedClosureFix input)
  IO.println s!"closureTriples={graph.length}"
  let immediate ← timed "immediate-inconsistency" (fun _ => immediateInconsistency graph)
  IO.println s!"immediate={immediate}"
  let tb ← timed "collect-axioms" (fun _ => collectAxioms graph)
  IO.println s!"axioms={tb.length}"
  let st ← timed "init-state" (fun _ => initState graph)
  IO.println s!"nodes={st.nodes.length}"
  let st := { st with tbox := tb }
  let clash ← timed "first-clash-check" (fun _ => clashNodes graph st)
  IO.println s!"firstClash={clash}"
  let pass ← profilePass tb graph st
  IO.println s!"firstPassChanged={pass.2} nodes={pass.1.nodes.length} totalMs={(← IO.monoMsNow) - start}"
  return 0

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, os, signal, time, json, hashlib
root=Path('/Users/danbri/working/factoidal')
out=Path('/private/tmp/factoidal-dl-population-20260908'); out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
binary=root/'formal/lean4/.lake/build/bin/l4factoidal'
R='http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#'; O='http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#'; E='http://example.org/scale/'
rows=[]
for n in [100,500,1000]:
    lines=[f'<{E}U> <{O}unionOf> _:list0 .',f'_:list0 <{R}first> <{E}A> .',f'_:list0 <{R}rest> _:list1 .',f'_:list1 <{R}first> <{E}B> .',f'_:list1 <{R}rest> <{R}nil> .',f'<{E}NotA> <{O}complementOf> <{E}A> .',f'<{E}NotB> <{O}complementOf> <{E}B> .']
    for i in range(n): lines += [f'<{E}x{i}> <{R}type> <{E}U> .',f'<{E}x{i}> <{R}type> <{E}NotA> .']
    for kind in ['open','contradiction']:
        text='\n'.join(lines+([f'<{E}x{n-1}> <{R}type> <{E}NotB> .'] if kind=='contradiction' else []))+'\n'
        path=out/f'{n}-{kind}.nq'; path.write_text(text)
        cmd=[str(binary),'owl-consistent',str(path),'--fuel','64']
        start=time.monotonic()
        with (out/'stdout').open('w') as so,(out/'stderr').open('w') as se:
            p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=so,stderr=se,start_new_session=True)
            timeout=False
            while True:
                pid,status,usage=os.wait4(p.pid,os.WNOHANG)
                if pid: break
                if time.monotonic()-start>30:
                    timeout=True; os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL); pid,status,usage=os.wait4(p.pid,0); break
                time.sleep(.02)
        row={'instances':n,'kind':kind,'input_triples':len(text.splitlines()),'input_bytes':len(text.encode()),'input_sha256':hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),'command':cmd,'wall_s':time.monotonic()-start,'timeout_s':30,'timeout':timeout,'exit_code':os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status),'peak_rss_bytes':usage.ru_maxrss,'user_s':usage.ru_utime,'system_s':usage.ru_stime,'stdout':(out/'stdout').read_text(),'stderr':(out/'stderr').read_text(),'concurrent_agent_work':True}
        rows.append(row); print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
        (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, os, signal, time, json, hashlib
root=Path('/Users/danbri/working/factoidal')
out=Path('/private/tmp/factoidal-dl-population-union-20260908'); out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
binary=root/'formal/lean4/.lake/build/bin/l4factoidal'
R='http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#'; O='http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#'; E='http://example.org/scale/'
rows=[]
for n in [100,500,1000,4000,8000]:
    lines=[f'<{E}U> <{O}unionOf> _:list0 .',f'_:list0 <{R}first> <{E}A> .',f'_:list0 <{R}rest> _:list1 .',f'_:list1 <{R}first> <{E}B> .',f'_:list1 <{R}rest> <{R}nil> .',f'<{E}NotA> <{O}complementOf> <{E}A> .',f'<{E}NotB> <{O}complementOf> <{E}B> .']
    for i in range(n): lines += [f'<{E}x{i}> <{R}type> <{E}U> .',f'<{E}x{i}> <{R}type> <{E}NotA> .']
    for kind in ['open','contradiction']:
        text='\n'.join(lines+([f'<{E}x{n-1}> <{R}type> <{E}NotB> .'] if kind=='contradiction' else []))+'\n'
        path=out/f'{n}-{kind}.nq'; path.write_text(text)
        cmd=[str(binary),'owl-consistent',str(path),'--fuel','64']
        start=time.monotonic()
        with (out/'stdout').open('w') as so,(out/'stderr').open('w') as se:
            p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=so,stderr=se,start_new_session=True)
            timeout=False
            while True:
                pid,status,usage=os.wait4(p.pid,os.WNOHANG)
                if pid: break
                if time.monotonic()-start>30:
                    timeout=True; os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL); pid,status,usage=os.wait4(p.pid,0); break
                time.sleep(.02)
        row={'instances':n,'kind':kind,'input_triples':len(text.splitlines()),'input_bytes':len(text.encode()),'input_sha256':hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),'command':cmd,'wall_s':time.monotonic()-start,'timeout_s':30,'timeout':timeout,'exit_code':os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status),'peak_rss_bytes':usage.ru_maxrss,'user_s':usage.ru_utime,'system_s':usage.ru_stime,'stdout':(out/'stdout').read_text(),'stderr':(out/'stderr').read_text(),'concurrent_agent_work':True}
        rows.append(row); print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
        (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')

qudt_initial_clash_diagnostic.source:
import L4Factoidal.Syntax.Turtle
import L4Factoidal.OWL.RLClosureIndexed
import L4Factoidal.OWL.Refute

open L4Factoidal.RDF L4Factoidal.Syntax L4Factoidal.OWL.Refute

def timed {α : Type} (name : String) (run : Unit → α) : IO α := do
  let start ← IO.monoMsNow
  let ref ← IO.mkRef (run ())
  let stop ← IO.monoMsNow
  let value ← ref.get
  IO.println s!"phase={name} ms={stop - start}"
  (← IO.getStdout).flush
  return value

def reportClash (g : Graph) (st : RState) : IO Unit := do
  IO.println s!"identificationClash={identificationClash g st}"
  let mut shown := 0
  for n in st.nodes do
    let ls := labelsOf st n.id
    let bad := ls.filter (clashForLabel g st n.id ls)
    let dr := datatypeRangeClash st n.id ls
    let dc := datatypeCardinalityClash st ls
    let count := countingClash st ls
    if !bad.isEmpty || dr || dc || count then
      IO.println s!"CLASH node={repr n.id} labels={repr ls} badLabels={repr bad} datatypeRange={dr} datatypeCardinality={dc} counting={count}"
      let asserted := g.filter (fun t => t.s == n.id)
      IO.println s!"NODE-TRIPLES {repr (asserted.take 35)}"
      shown := shown + 1
      if shown >= 3 then break

def main (args : List String) : IO UInt32 := do
  let some path := args.head? | return 2
  let text ← IO.FS.readFile path
  let parsed ← timed "parse" (fun _ => parseTurtle text)
  let .ok input := parsed | return 2
  let g ← timed "closure" (fun _ => L4Factoidal.OWL.RL.indexedClosureFix input)
  let immediate ← timed "immediate" (fun _ => immediateInconsistency g)
  IO.println s!"immediate={immediate}"
  let tb ← timed "collect" (fun _ => collectAxioms g)
  let init ← timed "init" (fun _ => initState g)
  let mut st := { init with tbox := tb }
  for k in [0:4] do
    let clash ← timed "clash" (fun _ => clashNodes g st)
    IO.println s!"step={k} clash={clash} nodes={st.nodes.length}"
    if clash then
      reportClash g st
      return 0
    let pass ← timed "pass" (fun _ => onePass tb g st)
    st := pass.1
    IO.println s!"changed={pass.2}"
  return 0

hard_timeout_wire_probe.source:
import Harness.OwlProbe
open L4Factoidal.RDF

def p : WfIri := ⟨"urn:wire:p", rfl⟩

def mkGraph (n : Nat) : Graph :=
  (List.range n).map fun i =>
    ⟨.bnode ("raw id / " ++ toString i), p, .bnode ("object id / " ++ toString (n - i))⟩

def wireMeasure (n : Nat) : IO Unit := do
  let g := mkGraph n
  let t0 ← IO.monoMsNow
  match OwlProbe.refuteWireGraph g with
  | .error e => IO.println s!"WIRE n={n} error={e}"
  | .ok s =>
      let t1 ← IO.monoMsNow
      match OwlProbe.parseRefuteWireGraph s with
      | .error e => IO.println s!"WIRE n={n} parse_error={e}"
      | .ok g' =>
          let t2 ← IO.monoMsNow
          IO.println s!"WIRE n={n} bytes={s.utf8ByteSize} encode_ms={t1-t0} decode_ms={t2-t1} triples={g'.length}"

#eval do
  wireMeasure 1000
  wireMeasure 2000
  wireMeasure 4000

import L4Factoidal.Syntax.Turtle
import L4Factoidal.OWL.RLClosureIndexed
import L4Factoidal.OWL.Refute

open L4Factoidal.RDF L4Factoidal.Syntax L4Factoidal.OWL.Refute

def timed {α : Type} (name : String) (run : Unit → α) : IO α := do
  let start ← IO.monoMsNow
  let ref ← IO.mkRef (run ())
  let stop ← IO.monoMsNow
  let value ← ref.get
  IO.println s!"phase={name} ms={stop - start}"
  (← IO.getStdout).flush
  return value

def main (args : List String) : IO UInt32 := do
  let some path := args.head? | return 2
  let text ← IO.FS.readFile path
  let .ok input := L4Factoidal.Syntax.parseTurtle text | return 2
  IO.println s!"input={input.length} bound={L4Factoidal.OWL.RL.closureFuelBound input}"
  let g100 ← timed "closure100" (fun _ => L4Factoidal.OWL.RL.indexedClosure input 100)
  IO.println s!"g100={g100.length}"
  let gfix ← timed "closureFix" (fun _ => L4Factoidal.OWL.RL.indexedClosureFix input)
  IO.println s!"gfix={gfix.length} sameOrder={g100 == gfix}"
  let c100 ← timed "clash100" (fun _ => clashNodes g100 (initStateIndexed g100))
  let cfix ← timed "clashFix" (fun _ => clashNodes gfix (initStateIndexed gfix))
  IO.println s!"clash100={c100} clashFix={cfix}"

import L4Factoidal.Syntax.Turtle
import L4Factoidal.OWL.RLClosureIndexed
import L4Factoidal.OWL.Refute

open L4Factoidal.RDF L4Factoidal.Syntax L4Factoidal.OWL.Refute

def timed {α : Type} (name : String) (run : Unit → α) : IO α := do
  let start ← IO.monoMsNow
  let ref ← IO.mkRef (run ())
  let stop ← IO.monoMsNow
  let value ← ref.get
  IO.println s!"phase={name} ms={stop - start}"
  (← IO.getStdout).flush
  return value

def quietTimed {α : Type} (run : Unit → α) : IO (α × Nat) := do
  let start ← IO.monoNanosNow
  let ref ← IO.mkRef (run ())
  let stop ← IO.monoNanosNow
  return ((← ref.get), stop - start)

def profilePass (tb : List (L4Factoidal.OWL.ClassExpr × L4Factoidal.OWL.ClassExpr))
    (g : Graph) (st : RState) : IO (RState × Bool) := do
  let start ← IO.monoNanosNow
  let (labelIndex, tIndex) ← quietTimed (fun _ => buildNamedAxiomIndex tb)
  let (functional, tFunctional) ← quietTimed (fun _ => injectFunctional st)
  let (globals, tGlobals) ← quietTimed (fun _ => injectGlobalAxioms tb functional.1)
  let mut current := globals.1
  let mut changed := functional.2 || globals.2
  let mut lookupNs := 0
  let mut labelNs := 0
  let mut axiomNs := 0
  let mut edgeNs := 0
  let mut conjNs := 0
  let mut labels := 0
  for node in globals.1.nodes do
    let (ls, tLookup) ← quietTimed (fun _ => labelsOf current node.id)
    lookupNs := lookupNs + tLookup
    for label in ls do
      labels := labels + 1
      let (applied, tLabel) ← quietTimed (fun _ => applyLabelRules g current node.id label)
      current := applied.1
      changed := changed || applied.2
      labelNs := labelNs + tLabel
      let (axioms, tAxiom) ← quietTimed (fun _ =>
        applyAxiomsDispatched labelIndex tb current node.id label)
      current := axioms.1
      changed := changed || axioms.2
      axiomNs := axiomNs + tAxiom
    let (edges, tEdge) ← quietTimed (fun _ => applyAxiomsEdges tb g current node.id)
    current := edges.1
    changed := changed || edges.2
    edgeNs := edgeNs + tEdge
    let (conjs, tConj) ← quietTimed (fun _ => applyAxiomsConj tb current node.id)
    current := conjs.1
    changed := changed || conjs.2
    conjNs := conjNs + tConj
  let total := (← IO.monoNanosNow) - start
  IO.println s!"pass indexMs={tIndex/1000000} functionalMs={tFunctional/1000000} globalMs={tGlobals/1000000} lookupMs={lookupNs/1000000} labelMs={labelNs/1000000} axiomMs={axiomNs/1000000} edgeMs={edgeNs/1000000} conjMs={conjNs/1000000} sumMs={(tIndex+tFunctional+tGlobals+lookupNs+labelNs+axiomNs+edgeNs+conjNs)/1000000} totalMs={total/1000000} labelVisits={labels}"
  return (current, changed)

def main (args : List String) : IO UInt32 := do
  let some path := args.head? | return 2
  let start ← IO.monoMsNow
  let text ← IO.FS.readFile path
  let parsed ← timed "parse-turtle" (fun _ => parseTurtle text)
  let .ok input := parsed | IO.println "parse failed"; return 2
  IO.println s!"inputTriples={input.length}"
  let graph ← timed "indexed-closure" (fun _ => L4Factoidal.OWL.RL.indexedClosure input 100)
  IO.println s!"closureTriples={graph.length}"
  let immediate ← timed "immediate-inconsistency" (fun _ => immediateInconsistency graph)
  IO.println s!"immediate={immediate}"
  let tb ← timed "collect-axioms" (fun _ => collectAxioms graph)
  IO.println s!"axioms={tb.length}"
  let st ← timed "init-state" (fun _ => initState graph)
  IO.println s!"nodes={st.nodes.length}"
  let st := { st with tbox := tb }
  let clash ← timed "first-clash-check" (fun _ => clashNodes graph st)
  IO.println s!"firstClash={clash}"
  let pass ← profilePass tb graph st
  IO.println s!"firstPassChanged={pass.2} nodes={pass.1.nodes.length} totalMs={(← IO.monoMsNow) - start}"
  return 0
